cohort: The study included 13,651 term, singleton, cephalic, spontaneous vaginal deliveries at the Galilee Medical Center.
finding: Early-career midwives, evening shift deliveries, and deliveries during the last two hours of a shift were independently associated with an increased risk of OASIS in spontaneous vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: The protective effect of experienced midwives against OASIS was particularly evident in spontaneous vaginal deliveries performed without an episiotomy.
